note: Golden fixture mau cho validate.js kiem tra sau. Dinh dang: moi case co script (ten file script chay), input (tham so truyen vao execute), expect.contains (chuoi phai xuat hien trong ket qua JSON) va expect.minItems (so item toi thieu). Khi lam extension that: thay input bang URL/tu khoa that, thay contains bang ten truyen/chuong that, tang minItems theo thuc te (vd. toc cua truyen dai phai co minItems lon). Case detail/toc dung cung mot URL truyen that. Luu y: day la fixture MAU (example.com khong co that) — validate chi kiem tra dinh dang, khong chay that len example.com.
